npc_ashara__daddies.notes: Blood already collected by the cult. Related to Maelis (a clone with severed tie during the conflict era) — NOT related to Zersayth. Origin at Sanctus Alarus.
npc_ashara__daddies.name: Ashara

npc_kairon__daddies.notes: Blood already collected by the cult. Descent tied to Zersayth's origin line. Parents (Kairon's Dad/Mom) both died at Sanctus Alarus, killed by Maelis.
npc_kairon__daddies.name: Kairon

npc_lark__daddies.notes: Descendant of Celastris and Zalrin Golderth; can channel the Heartroot Trees.
npc_lark__daddies.name: Lark

npc_liora__daddies.notes: Blood already collected by the cult. Daughter of Lian'del — confirmed parent-child sacrifice.
npc_liora__daddies.name: Liora

npc_rurik__daddies.notes: Descendant of Ormaelin Flintfury; can channel the Crystal Obelisk.
npc_rurik__daddies.name: Rurik

npc_seris__daddies.notes: Blood already collected by the cult. Related to Cyris the Deathslayer. Romantically involved with Ka'el Ashfang, who doesn't yet know of her bloodline tie.
npc_seris__daddies.name: Seris

npc_nmrmntvjsspy2__daddies.notes: Current king of Sanctus Alarus. Descendant of Aeris Bloom. Owns/controls Varina. Commands three generals: Ka'el Ashfang, Maelis, Sszaryth. Believes he is destined for godhood by completing The Great Undoing — must collect the remaining artifacts (Ring of Desire, Crystal of Healing, Seed of Life, Song of Clouds) plus the bloodlines of all seven original participants (six PCs + already-collected NPCs).
npc_nmrmntvjsspy2__daddies.name: Alaris Bloom

npc_nmrmnvpi621fn__daddies.notes: Ancient necromancer, general under Alaris Bloom. Rebuilt herself over centuries; believes this era offers an unprecedented opportunity. Created Ashara as a clone with a severed tie during the conflict era. Killed Kairon's parents.
npc_nmrmnvpi621fn__daddies.name: Maelis

npc_nmrmnvzt2jjtn__daddies.notes: General under Alaris Bloom — pale blue drow illusion master. Secretly desires Alaris's power rather than serving him loyally. Uses sensory/identity illusions on cultists, sometimes appearing as Alaris. 'Trust must overcome perception' theme. Currently holding Ka'el Ashfang captive.
npc_nmrmnvzt2jjtn__daddies.name: Sszaryth

npc_nmrmow9d7qmum__daddies.notes: General under Alaris Bloom. Good-hearted but misguided. Currently captured by Sszaryth. Romantically involved with Seris (previously with Seraphine Stillborn); doesn't yet know Seris's bloodline tie to Cyris.
npc_nmrmow9d7qmum__daddies.name: Ka'el Ashfang

note_nmrmp0rqe2zgd__daddies.notes: Occurred at Azurite Pointe during the Crystal Faire. NOT connected to the fog or the Crystal Obelisk's destruction — a separate incident. Heroes defended the town successfully before the army's arrival/evacuation.
note_nmrmp0rqe2zgd__daddies.name: Zombie Attack

location_nmrmp1be8glla__daddies.notes: Site of the Crystal Faire and the Zombie Attack. The Crystal Obelisk here was destroyed by army explosives during the evacuation to Sanctus Alarus — not by zombies or the fog. No obelisk remains at this location.
location_nmrmp1be8glla__daddies.name: Azurite Pointe

note_nmrmp4rf6o5sh__daddies.notes:
Was meant to be a saving act, gone awry — Cyris the Deathslayer (Aeris's bodyguard) accidentally added his own blood while intervening in a conflict during the ritual's execution, corrupting it.

The 7 were to sacrifice their deepest loves.
note_nmrmp4rf6o5sh__daddies.name: The Great Undoing

npc_nmrmpc0ysqc35__daddies.notes: King of War - Human. Sacrificed the Ring of Desire (still uncollected/missing). Ancestor of current king Alaris Bloom.
npc_nmrmpc0ysqc35__daddies.name: Aeris Bloom

npc_nmrmph770ga3n__daddies.notes: Queen of Life - Dryad. Sacrificed the Seed of Life (still uncollected/missing). Deliberately cultivated the Heartroot Trees with the dryads in anticipation of sabotage (GM Truth — hide from players).
npc_nmrmph770ga3n__daddies.name: Celastris

npc_nmrmpil4b8zzh__daddies.notes: Queen of the Earth - Dwarf. Sacrificed the Crystal of Healing (NOT yet introduced into the campaign — distinct from the Crystal Obelisk). Deliberately built the Obelisks with the dwarves in anticipation of sabotage (GM Truth — hide from players).
npc_nmrmpil4b8zzh__daddies.name: Ormaelin Flintfury

npc_nmrmpkd7275im__daddies.notes: King of the Sky - Illithid Dragon. Sacrificed the Song of Clouds, leaving travel to the Far Realm permanently open. Romantically linked to Varina. No direct connection to Sszaryth, Alaris, Maelis, or Ashara.
npc_nmrmpkd7275im__daddies.name: Zersayth, the Voiceless

note_nmrmpm9ovw6qo__daddies.notes: Protection from Void. Cultivated by the dryads — deliberately built in anticipation of sabotage (GM Truth — hide from players).
note_nmrmpm9ovw6qo__daddies.name: Heartroot Trees

note_nmrmpmnilcq9j__daddies.notes: Protection from Null. Created by the dwarves — deliberately built in anticipation of sabotage (GM Truth — hide from players). Destroyed by army explosives during the evacuation from Azurite Pointe to Sanctus Alarus — not by zombies or the fog.
note_nmrmpmnilcq9j__daddies.name: Crystal Obelisk

npc_nmrmpsjzlagoe__daddies.notes: Lich Queen. Sacrificed blood of/for Zersayth, romantically linked to him during the ritual. Now owned/controlled by Alaris Bloom (modern era) — was under Aeris Bloom's household during the original ritual conflict.
npc_nmrmpsjzlagoe__daddies.name: Varina

npc_nmrx1r2a3ga8r__daddies.notes: Met Celastris in the deep forest
npc_nmrx1r2a3ga8r__daddies.name: Zalrin Golderth

note_nmrx2hwrmr27k__daddies.notes:
Blood of Liora - Lian'del
Blood of Zersayth - Varina
Ring of Desire - Aeris (still uncollected/missing)
Crystal of Healing - Ormaelin (NOT yet introduced into the campaign)
Seed of Life - Celastris (still uncollected/missing)
Accidental participant - Cyris (added his own blood while protecting Aeris)
Song of Clouds - Zersayth (still uncollected/missing)
note_nmrx2hwrmr27k__daddies.name: Required Sacrifice

location_nmsfae1ot5jvh__daddies.notes: origin of Zersayth and the fog
location_nmsfae1ot5jvh__daddies.name: Far Realms
